_note: Standing reference data the repair desk reads. Deterministic, versioned, and citable — every Tier A repair must name the entry here that justified it.

currencyMinorUnits._source: ISO 4217 minor units. Values other than 2 are the ones that break naive formatters.

chargeBearerRules._source: SEPA: EPC132-08 SCT C2PSP IG 2025 v1.0 items 2.75/2.98 — SLEV only. CBPR+: ECB T2 Contact Group 'HVPS+ and CBPR+ differences' 20 Jun 2023 item 10 — SLEV and DEBT removed from CBPR+. Fedwire: Fed ISO 20022 Format FAQ Q16 — all four valid, SHAR recommended.

bicDirectory._source: Institution directory extract. Branch code XXX denotes head office (ISO 9362).

clearingSystemMembers._source: Fedwire participant extract. ABA check digit per weights 3,7,1 repeating.

accountRegistry._note: Name held on the account by the account-servicing institution. Used to DETECT a name mismatch. A mismatch is never auto-corrected — the registry name is a candidate, not a confirmation.

purposeCodes._source: ExternalPurpose1Code, ISO 20022 external code sets 1Q2026. Subset carried by this desk.

statusReasonCodes._source: ExternalStatusReason1Code, ISO 20022 external code sets 1Q2026. Definitions verbatim, including the registry's own typos.
statusReasonCodes.AC01: IncorrectAccountNumber — Account number is invalid or missing.
statusReasonCodes.AM03: NotAllowedCurrency — Specified message amount is an non processable currency outside of existing agreement
statusReasonCodes.BE01: InconsistenWithEndCustomer — Identification of end customer is not consistent with associated account number.
statusReasonCodes.BE04: MissingCreditorAddress — Specification of creditor's address, which is required for payment, is missing/not correct.
statusReasonCodes.BE19: InvalidChargeBearerCode — Charge bearer code for transaction type is invalid
statusReasonCodes.RC01: BankIdentifierIncorrect — Bank identifier code specified in the message has an incorrect format.
statusReasonCodes.RC08: InvalidClearingSystemMemberIdentifier — ClearingSystemMemberidentifier is invalid or missing.
statusReasonCodes.RR03: MissingCreditorNameOrAddress — Specification of the creditor's name and/or address needed for regulatory requirements is insufficient or missing.
